items.source: Uses of ContextCustomizerFactories.MergeMode in org.springframework.test.context

Enumeration of modes that dictate whether explicitly declared factories are merged with the default factories when @ContextCustomizerFactories is declared on a class that does not inherit factories from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 枚举 modes，用于规定当在类上声明了 @ContextCustomizerFactories 且该类未从父类或外部类继承工厂时，显式声明的工厂是否与默认工厂合并。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。
